#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date."""
import datetime
import os

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover.pdf"
TMP = "report_with_cover.tmp.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def main() -> None:
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
        raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {INPUT} not found in the workspace")

    # 1. Build the cover page (letter size) with title and current date.
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 3.5 * inch, TITLE)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 4.5 * inch, today)
    c.save()
    print(f"Created cover page: {COVER}")
    print(f"  Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"  Date:  {today}")

    # 2. Prepend the cover page to the report (read original fully first).
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
    report_page_count = len(report_reader.pages)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(TMP, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    os.replace(TMP, OUTPUT)
    print(f"Merged {report_page_count} report page(s) + 1 cover page -> {OUTPUT}")

    # 3. Validate the result: page count and text of the cover and next page.
    check = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
    print(f"Output page count: {len(check.pages)}")
    print("--- Page 1 (cover) text ---")
    print(check.pages[0].extract_text() or "(no text extracted)")
    print("--- Page 2 (first report page) text, first 200 chars ---")
    t2 = check.pages[1].extract_text()
    print((t2[:200] if t2 else "(no text extracted)"))

    os.remove(COVER)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
